```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Eight of the ten hottest years ever recorded have occurred during the past ten years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Scientists predict a daunting range of likely effects from global warming.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Much of Florida and Louisiana can be submerged underwater.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More record floods, droughts, heat waves, and wildfires can occur.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Diseases and pests can spread to new areas.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Crop failures and famines can occur.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Melting glaciers, stronger storms, and rising seas can occur.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These effects are the predicted result of human actions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New human actions can prevent these effects.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore led the Partnership for a New Generation of Vehicles, which helped spur the development of high-performing cars that get far better gas mileage while meeting emissions standards.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a need to help Americans afford new cars.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a commitment to improving fuel economy in a way that preserves and creates jobs for American workers, and delivers products that consumers want to buy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There is a recommendation that the oil industry join in producing much cleaner fuels that will allow automotive environmental equipment to achieve the maximum possible reductions in emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
